scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with tall buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a large white car parked on the left side of the street and several cars parked along the sidewalk. The street is paved with asphalt and has a few cracks and potholes. A tree-lined median divides the street into two lanes, with a pedestrian crossing marked by a yellow line. The sky is clear and blue, suggesting a sunny day. The buildings have a mix of modern and traditional facades, with some featuring balconies and ornate details. The street is relatively quiet, with only a few people visible in the distance.
scene_analysis.buildings: Left building: cream rendered facade with stone quoins at the corners. Right: exposed red brick upper floors above a polished granite shopfront. Foreground: hexagonal ceramic pavement tiles.
